{{Quote|Listening posts are already in place in the Bacrana, Rehn, and Skone systems.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]] in a communique to General [[Natara]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
The '''Rehn system''' was located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was the home of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rehn VII]], which was capable of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] production as well as a degree of manufacturing capabilities.<ref name="FBS" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] designated the [[Star system/Legends|system]] as a staging area for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. As part of the new security requirements, valid permits were required to travel to the Rehn system. Strict enforcement meant harsh penalties were levied on authorized arrivals. [[Picket ship/Legends|Picket ships]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] stations were used to patrol the outer edges of the system.<ref name="FBS" />

Despite the best efforts of the Imperial Navy, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Brak Sector Force]] managed to establish a [[listening post]] on Rehn VII.<ref name="FBS" />
